description: Colony Survival mechanics rebuilt inside Minecraft 1.21.11 as a Fabric mod. 27 colonist jobs, nightly waves, food economy, research, and colony management.

mods.name: ColonyCraft
mods.description: Colony Survival mechanics in Minecraft! Place a Colony Banner, recruit Colonists, assign them jobs, collect resources automatically and defend your colony from nightly monster waves. Features 25+ jobs, quest system, decorative Chisel tool, wave warnings, and much more.
